Frequently Asked Questions

Is FACTS really free?

Yes! The free plan (Levels 1–3) includes the manual FACTS ledger, basic dashboards, and allocation tracking. Paid plans start at $14.99/mo (Individual) with unlimited Plaid syncing, debt tools, and more. You'll never pay extra or see ads.

How is this different from other budgeting apps?

Most budgeting apps focus on tracking expenses AFTER you spend. FACTS flips this — you allocate your income BEFORE spending. It's proactive vs. reactive. Plus, we use just 6 categories instead of dozens, making it simple and sustainable.

Do I need to connect my bank account?

No! You can use FACTS without any bank connection by manually logging transactions (takes 10 seconds). Bank sync via Plaid is optional and only available on paid plans.

What if I don't like the 50/10/10/10/10/10 percentages?

The default percentages are just a starting point based on proven financial principles. You can customize them to match your life — maybe 40% Necessities, 20% Legacy, etc. It's your money, your rules.

Is my financial data secure?

Absolutely. We use bank-level encryption (AES-256) and never sell your data. Bank connections use Plaid (trusted by 11,000+ apps). Your data stays yours — always.

Can I use this with my partner or spouse?

Yes! Family sharing is available on the Family plan and above. Invite your partner to collaborate on allocations, see shared transactions, and work toward financial goals together.

What Makes Up Your Score

Payment History 35%

Pay every bill on time, every time. Even one late payment hurts.

Amounts Owed 30%

Keep credit utilization below 30%, ideally under 10% for top scores.

Length of History 15%

Keep older accounts open. The average age of your accounts matters.

New Credit 10%

Limit hard inquiries. Each application can drop your score 5–10 pts.

Credit Mix 10%

A mix of cards, loans, and installment accounts shows healthy credit behavior.
